selection_rule: A guide page with at least 2 impressions at average position <= 15 in the 28-day Search Console window (gsc_search_analytics_export.json by_page). Home, hubs, state hubs and utility pages are excluded; state hubs get the audience blocks instead. build_search_plan.mjs lists every page that meets the rule in strengthening_candidates so the next pass is data, not a guess.
what_strengthening_means: title + H1 aligned to the query Google shows for the page (or the page's topic phrase when Search Console anonymises it), a definition paragraph (data-search-definition), an FAQ from the real questions with FAQPage JSON-LD (data-search-faq), and links from the homepage and the guides hub (data-search-ranked-links). Source of each page: its page-set JSON field search_strengthening; rendered by scripts/search_intelligence/render_blocks.js.

pages.query_shown: what red flags should i watch for when evaluating trt providers — things like hidden fees, rotating providers, or lack of lab monitoring?
